parsed.title: STAY CALM
parsed.body:
Move the [intruder] by 1 in any direction.

OR

COMMAND
Choose your Room or neighbouring one,
each [character] in that Room draws 1[actionCard].

REACTION
When a Character in your Room (including
you) would resolve an Intruder Attack:
Ignore that Attack.
